1. Altcoins in general
Every cycle again, the Altcoin dilution got worse: more tokens, more sectors, more chains, more places to buy, more everything. 
Every cycle again, it became more challenging to make money in Altseason. More work is required to focus on the right sectors that catch the attention and money inflow. 
I think the market will become easier once Bitcoin Dominance breaks down.
Until now, the inflow of new people was pretty low, and it was mainly us + people that left us coming back. This creates a high PvP environment where money only rotates and flows into specific niches. 
I do think a few events and a couple of (potential) upcoming events will change this:
